designationHistory.indexText: Laguna Atascosa National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1946 to provide habitat for wintering waterfowl and other migratory birds, principally redhead ducks.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
